description.en: Configures the item and 3D position for the "pop item" effect created with CMND_CREATE_POP_ITEM (e.g. the item that pops out of an opened treasure chest).
ID of the item to show popping out.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Show the collected item popping out of the treasure chest
CMND_SET_POP_ITEM(itemID, posX, posY, posZ);
